A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (27 September 2019).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-darkhours-PC-Errata-2019-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Dark Hours]]: The game text is reworded: “Deploy on a site under "nighttime conditions." One at a time, target each non-droid character here and draw destiny. If destiny &gt; ability, character 'sleeps' until end of your next turn (power, forfeit, and ability = 0, game text is canceled, and may not pilot, drive, or move). At the end of your next turn, lose Effect.” A white italic “E” is added in the black lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
